provenance.query: query($t: String!, $after: String, $since: DateTimeOrDuration!) { issues(filter: { team: { key: { eq: $t } }, createdAt: { gte: $since } }, first: 250, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { identifier title createdAt state { type } labels { nodes { name } } botActor { name } description } } }
provenance.redaction: Titles and descriptions are NOT stored. `fp` is alert-to-linear.fingerprint(title), a truncated sha256. This repo is public; see validate-separation Gate 1.2.
